s: July 10, 2025 - A common method for hedging is through put options. Puts give the holder the right, but not the obligation, to sell the underlying security at a pre-set price on or before the date it expires. For example, if Morty buys 100 shares of PLC stock at $10 per share, and hedges the investment by purchasing a put option with a strike price of $8 expiring in one year.
